description:
***Amendment 001 - The purpose of this Amendment is to incorporate responses to vendor questions.  The response submission time has been extended until 2:00PM EST on April 07, 2026.

The U.S. Department of Labor, Employee Benefit Security Administration (EBSA), seeks information/solutions for Special Financial Assistance (SFA) Program – Casework Actuarial Services in accordance with the attached Performance Work Statement (PWS). This is a Request for Information (RFI). Please submit questions using Attachment 01 - QA Log NLT March 24, 2026. Responses to the RFI are due on April 03, 2026 at 2:00PM EST.
